_comment: CLOSEBOOK COMMITTED-CASH BUDGET — the cash the business has actually
committed, as opposed to the sandbox balance which is just capacity.
The Airwallex sandbox pre-funds ~10,000,000 in every major currency, so
policy written against the raw balance never binds: the USD 5,000 reserve
floor and the USD 2,500 auto-pay limit would never fire and the demo would
show nothing. Closebook therefore tracks its own committed-cash budget and
treats the sandbox balance as the ceiling of what it COULD move.
expected_inflows_minor: receivables already invoiced and reasonably
expected to land (the business's committed cash).
earmarked_minor:     cash already reserved for a known obligation.
available = expected_inflows - earmarked. Policy is written against that.
Minor units throughout (integer), consistent with the rest of the system.
